text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I asked Mejiro Ramonu how her day off went—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...All those videos proved to be wonderful food for thought."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even now, they still gallop through my mind...
The legendary Umamusume of generations past...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she spend her time watching past race footage?
Either way, it seems she made the most of her day off!
